title: gatk pipeline - FASTQ input samplesheet schema
description: Schema for the samplesheet file containing FASTQ file paths. Multiple rows with the same sample name will be treated as technical replicates and merged.

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and cannot contain spaces
sample.description: Custom sample name for the input FASTQ files. Multiple rows with the same sample name will be treated as technical replicates.

fastq_1.errorMessage: FastQ file for reads 1 must be provided, cannot contain spaces, must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz', and must exist
fastq_1.description: Path to the FASTQ file for read 1. Can be a local path or S3 URI.

fastq_2.errorMessage: FastQ file for reads 2 cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'
fastq_2.description: Path to the FASTQ file for read 2. Can be a local path or S3 URI. Leave empty for single-end data.
